artifact: P4 DRAFT PREREGISTRATION — NOT FROZEN, NOT AUTHORIZED. Design-draft companion to evidence/p4/p4-design-draft.md (DRAFT v1). This file exists so the architecture review can preregister-by-reference; every field below is provisional until the review returns and the qualification freezes it.
title: Autonomous upstream reliability — can the real workflow + real LLM produce a valid BUILD-entry state without fixture replay?
research_question: Can the real Stratum workflow, using a real LLM rather than scripted upstream fixture replay, consistently produce a valid BUILD-entry state?

relation_to_prior_experiments.P2: 0/9 workflows reached BUILD; root cause: campaign-driver settings clobber (10/10 runs at degraded budgets) + upstream generative exhaustion; P4 prevents and measures both
relation_to_prior_experiments.P3: 3/3 BUILD publications from a replayed entry state (QUALIFIED SUPPORT) — P4 removes the replay
relation_to_prior_experiments.P4_is_not: a BUILD reliability study (P3's closed result), a task-generalization study, or a downstream-correctness study

primary_endpoint.definition: BUILD-entry readiness at the confirm checkpoint, assessed BEFORE any BUILD execution; the confirm decision remains pending

readiness_checks.R1_workflow_state: execution WorkItem live; cursor at confirm; well-formed pending checkpoint decision
readiness_checks.R2_authority: definition artifact with recorded definition_sha256 produced by THIS run's model output; execution WI references it as definitionSource
readiness_checks.R3_configuration: settings.json sha 5634b2e897eeb56467deae26da0dd9146c36dc192a61ded23196ee21b55925a2 verified at every step transition; installed once at campaign start; no campaign code writes it afterward
readiness_checks.R4_budget_on_wire: every archived upstream request carries max_tokens from the frozen per-step map (workflow_max_tokens) and frozen effort keys
readiness_checks.R5_edit_policy: workflowParameters carry allowedEditPaths/requiredEditPaths over the worker file
readiness_checks.R6_wire_integrity: all upstream turns guard-archived with wire_observation; zero unarchived provider calls

primary_endpoint.assessment_record: readiness-assessment.json per attempt: READY | NOT-READY + class + evidence pointers

not_ready_classes: budget-exhaustion-upstream (genuine finish_reason length at the CORRECT frozen budget)
procedure_classes_consume_nothing: CONFIG-DRIFT STOP (settings sha divergence — immediate campaign-terminal STOP with archived diff)
transport re-queue (bounded at 3, P3 discipline; ambiguity never censored)
guard evidence STOP (G1/G2 semantics inherited from P3)
crash recovery per charter v1.1 section 10 (retained/incomplete/resume)

sampling.task: single pinned input evidence/p3/inputs/issue-108.json (dd40147291edb7412eb0ccf57c3cadbd3f19ac8d7299306c0bc880419eb124c5) — same task as P3, now WITHOUT replay
sampling.design_rationale: fixed-task repetition measures delivery reliability without task-difficulty confounds; task generalization explicitly out of scope
sampling.denominator_rule: every launched workflow instance is evaluable (READY or NOT-READY+class); procedure classes consume nothing

model_regime: identical frozen regime: openrouter, z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, settings 5634b2e8 (full file with workflow_max_tokens + workflow_reasoning_effort), upstream per-step budgets honored and WIRE-VERIFIED

config_integrity.state_time_guard: settings sha verified before each upstream step; drift -> CONFIG-DRIFT STOP (procedure class)
config_integrity.request_time_guard: P3 config-guard composition wraps every upstream step; per-step contracts derived from the frozen settings
config_integrity.no_seed_rule: no seed()/instantiate-reset in the campaign path; settings installed exactly once per campaign

crash_recovery.implementation: ledger-driven resume in the P4 runner: attempt-counted = retained (never re-run/double-counted); mid-flight at crash = incomplete (archived under interrupted-*, discarded, consumes nothing); resume continues the original terminal condition
crash_recovery.logs: all orchestration output under the campaign evidence dir from process start

qualification_plan.L1_offline: scripted-provider end-to-end: READY path; each NOT-READY class induced+classified; clobber simulation -> CONFIG-DRIFT; drifted-budget request -> guard STOP; kill-and-resume (retained slot preserved); no-seed code-inspection gate
qualification_plan.L2_real_provider: one round, <= 6 calls, ops-qual namespace: define-shaped + design-shaped turns at frozen upstream budgets; 32768 reasoning-burn calibration (P2 hidden-burn anomaly); upstream tool-surface capture verification
qualification_plan.L3: N=3 campaign; first genuine upstream-to-BUILD-entry observation expected at attempt 1

reuse: workflow engine, decision repos, config-guard capture, evidence packaging, ledger + adjudicators, restoration, qualification patterns; NEW thin code: upstream per-step contract derivation, R1-R6 readiness function (pure), ledger-resume in the runner
stop_rules: immediate campaign-terminal STOP on CONFIG-DRIFT, out-of-policy disk writes during upstream, guard STOP, or evidence-archive failure — same shape as P3's frozen rules; on any STOP: archive, journal, return to operator
